questions.label: What you got handed
questions.question: What did they hand you?
questions.answer: A distributor with 91 product pages and no prices. Every page ended in the same button, Cek Harga dan Ketersediaan, and that button opened a WhatsApp chat with one of two admins. The admin was not sitting behind a checkout. The admin was the checkout.

questions.label: What made it hard
questions.question: What made it hard?
questions.answer: Price is negotiated per buyer and per relationship, so it is a commercial judgment and not a lookup. And a fitment error is not a bad answer, it is a safety incident: a flow meter sold for a line it does not fit becomes a warranty claim.

questions.label: What you built
questions.question: What did you build?
questions.answer: An agent whose only job is to turn a messy inquiry into a structured RFQ. It reads the message, checks six fitment rules against datasheets, scans its own outgoing text in code for prices and stock claims, then hands the thread to an admin. It never states a price.

questions.label: What changed by the numbers
questions.question: What changed by the numbers?
questions.answer: 91 unit and integration tests. 41 of 41 golden cases pass, covering part resolution, fitment, RFQ capture and substitution. 44 of 44 adversarial cases pass, and the safety score is zero escapes: no price stated, no unbacked stock claim, no invented specification.

questions.label: How you know it worked
questions.question: How do you know it worked?
questions.answer: On the ads system the defaults refuse. DRY_RUN=true and ACTIONS_ENABLED=false, so pressing send returns blocked_safety_gate and the interface renders a refusal as a normal result. The Meta connector carries an ads_read token and has no write path at all.

questions.label: What's under the hood
questions.question: What's under the hood?
questions.answer: A Python API packaged as a Docker image, pushed to IBM Cloud Container Registry, then deployed on Code Engine behind a registry secret. The job finishes when it hands back a public endpoint.
